model_type: HistGradientBoostingClassifier (scikit-learn 1.9.1), 400 trees, log-odds summed and passed through a sigmoid
target: the pool price at its 24 hour check is at least 80 percent below its frozen t0 price
decile_cuts_source: out-of-sample scores of the validation model (same recipe, trained on an earlier window) on the pools of the test window; the production model is scored on later pools, so these boundaries are a starting point until the service has enough live scores of its own
decile_cuts_insample_note: scores of the production model on its own last 14 training days: in-sample, kept only to show how far they sit from the frozen boundaries; never used for a decile

validation.note: measured on the VALIDATION model (trained on pools that entered through the validation training window, tested on later pools). The production model is the same recipe on more data; it has no out-of-time test of its own.
validation.test_window: pools that entered after an embargo week, through the last fully labelled day of that run
